The bug was premature rounding. The original code applied the discount to the unit price, rounded it, then multiplied by quantityâ€”this accumulated rounding error. The fix calculates the full line amount first, applies the discount, and rounds only once at the end. This gives the correct result of 899 cents instead of 900.

src_after.money.py:
def round_cents(value):
    """Round a fractional cent amount to a whole number of cents, half away
    from zero.

    Every price in this package passes through here, and this is the only
    place any rounding is allowed to happen.
    """
    return int(value + 0.5)
